question: Which of the following pacts suspended the Civil Disobedience Movement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gandhi-Irwin Pact**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Gandhi-Irwin Pact was signed on **5 March 1931** between Mahatma Gandhi and Lord Irwin, the Viceroy of India.
 
• This pact marked the **suspension of the Civil Disobedience Movement**, initiated by the Indian National Congress in 1930.
